patronOf.en-US: Patron of Lisbon and of vinedressers
patronOf.pt-BR: Padroeiro de Lisboa e dos vinhateiros

prayerExcerpt.en-US: That strong love by which the Martyr Saint Vincent triumphed over all bodily torments.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: O intenso amor que levou o diácono São Vicente a vencer todos os tormentos do martírio.

meta.face: A young man of about twenty-two, clean-shaven, with a pale, full oval face, wide at the cheekbones — a straight nose with a narrow bridge, heavy-lidded brown eyes under thin, level brows, a small rounded chin and a small, closed mouth; straight chestnut-brown hair parted in the middle and falling thickly to the jaw, covering the ears (no fringe, no tonsure, no curls), the eyes gently lowered in grave recollection.
meta.basis: Nuno Gonçalves's Lisbon panels (Vincent, patron of Lisbon) and Martorell show him beardless with straight chestnut hair to the jaw and a grave, lowered gaze. The rack, millstone and ravens are his own attributes, keeping him apart from Lawrence's gridiron.
